notes: Two-sample Hotelling T2 (the hotel2 PROC IML module, pooled variances) and Bartlett's test (PROC DISCRIM pool=test) on the Swiss bank-note data. 15 real + 15 fake rows extracted from data/swiss3.xlsx (same values, read via openpyxl-equivalent XML parsing since PROC IMPORT dbms=xlsx isn't exercised here) and inlined via DATALINES. The two groups are pre-split into swiss_real/swiss_fake DATA steps before PROC IML, rather than using READ ALL VAR{...} WHERE(...) INTO on the combined dataset as the source script does -- filed separately as a regression test; the pre-split keeps this bundle demonstrating genuinely correct, non-missing output.
